beats: A slice of bread was always one fixed number — no way to say he only ate half the potatoes.
You couldn't build a sandwich from its real parts, so the carb count was often just wrong.
Now every food stores its real values per 100 grams, straight from Matvaretabellen.
Parents adjust the exact grams he actually ate, and the insulin dose follows.
